propositions: Two untracked event JSON files were found in the persistent review-bot clone before A6-0b deployment, predating the current HEAD state with no tracked diff or merge/rebase/stash activity.
The TICKET_DIGEST.json file is a disposable unsigned derived cache superseded by newer committed digests for the same ticket, not a unique canonical event.
The CLAIM_ENRICH.json file is expired queue residue with a superseded later claim and DONE state in authoritative history.
Stranded event files must be identified as unique canonical data requiring recovery or duplicates/residue authorizing safe disposal before cleanup and ref-convergence verification.
Persistent clone cleanup requires proof that HEAD equals refs/remotes/origin/tickets and no untracked files remain before A6-1 publication window.
